articles.title: Maintain current contact details
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to CIS AWS Foundations 1.1.

articles.title: MFA is enabled for all IAM users with a console password
articles.rationale: The AWS connector raises an open finding for any console-password IAM user without an MFA device, gating purely programmatic identities out; that finding is the direct test for this recommendation.

articles.title: Do not setup access keys during initial user setup for all IAM users that have a console password

articles.title: Ensure credentials unused for 45 days or greater are disabled

articles.title: Ensure there is only one active access key available for any single IAM user
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to CIS AWS Foundations 1.13.

articles.title: Access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
articles.rationale: The AWS connector raises an open access-key-hygiene finding when an active key is older than the 90-day rotation SLO (or more than one active key exists); that finding is the direct test for this recommendation.

articles.title: Data protection by design and by default
articles.rationale: GDPR Article 25 is mapped for evidence that privacy controls and default settings are designed into personal-data systems.

articles.title: Processor
articles.rationale: GDPR Article 28 is mapped for processor inventory, agreement, and vendor-review evidence for personal-data processing.

articles.title: Records of processing activities
articles.rationale: GDPR Art. 30 — Each controller maintains a record of processing activities under its responsibility.

articles.title: Security of processing
articles.rationale: GDPR Art. 32 — Controllers and processors implement appropriate technical and organisational measures.

articles.title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority
articles.rationale: GDPR Art. 33 — Notification within 72 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach.

articles.title: Data protection impact assessment
articles.rationale: GDPR Article 35 is mapped for DPIA evidence over high-risk processing activities and related remediation findings.

articles.title: Risk analysis
articles.rationale: 45 CFR §164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A) is mapped for risk-analysis evidence over electronic-PHI systems.

articles.title: Risk management
articles.rationale: 45 CFR §164.308(a)(1)(ii)(B) is mapped for remediation and risk-reduction evidence after ePHI risks are identified.

articles.title: Information access management
articles.rationale: 45 CFR §164.308(a)(4) — Information access management standard.

articles.title: Encryption and decryption
articles.rationale: 45 CFR §164.312(a)(2)(iv) is mapped for encryption and decryption evidence over electronic-PHI systems.

articles.title: Audit controls
articles.rationale: 45 CFR §164.312(b) — Implement hardware, software, or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity.

articles.title: Transmission security
articles.rationale: 45 CFR §164.312(e) — Guard against unauthorized access to ePHI transmitted over an electronic communications network.
